metrics.recall_population: Only cases with kind retrieval contribute to expected-record recall; boundary, ui and integrity cases are reported separately.

limitations: All eight persona profiles are projected and unvalidated; case mapping does not establish that people need or accept them.
Expected records are evaluation targets only and must never be injected into the runtime query or retrieval input.
Candidate evidence is exact machine-extracted material; it is not complete legal authority, a specialist-reviewed answer or evidence of current applicability.
Boundary cases without source targets test gap reporting and non-fabrication, not positive retrieval recall.
UI cases require human observation; integrity cases require separate mutation execution. This producer does not claim either was run.
